agent.problem: This non-opening story card has four sentences: two telling the promise and two delivering the joke. Non-opening story cards are limited to one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The opening sentence retells God's promise to bring the exiles home from Jeremiah 24:6, but the card cites only Jeremiah 24:9. Its citation does not cover everything the card tells.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
